items.title: OpenAI previews ‘Ultrafast’ GPT-5.6 Sol running up to 14 times faster
items.title_zh: OpenAI 预览“Ultrafast”版 GPT-5.6 Sol，速度最高提升 14 倍
items.summary: OpenAI is previewing a new service tier called Ultrafast that can run its GPT-5.6 Sol model up to 14 times faster than standard processing.

items.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash launches three weeks after last model, live in Spark
items.title_zh: Gemini 3.7 Flash 发布：距上一代仅三周，已在 Spark 上线
items.summary: Google announced Gemini 3.7 Flash just three weeks after the last release, continuing its accelerated cadence, and it is now live in Spark. The model drew 609 points and 339 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Claude's new Scarlet Letter watermark is invisible—for now
items.title_zh: Claude 新的“红字”水印目前不可见——暂时如此
items.summary: Anthropic's new watermark, dubbed the Scarlet Letter, flags anything Claude processed — including human writing it only edited — and is currently invisible, according to Ars Technica.

items.title: Anthropic could be worth $2 trillion when it goes public
items.title_zh: Anthropic 上市时估值或达 2 万亿美元
items.summary: Ars Technica reports rapid revenue growth fuels hope that Claude maker Anthropic's IPO will be the biggest listing in history, with a potential valuation of $2 trillion.

items.title: Nvidia’s new $500B plan is risky but brilliant, especially for aging GPUs
items.title_zh: 英伟达新的 5000 亿美元计划：风险与聪明并存，尤其惠及老化 GPU
items.summary: TechCrunch reports Nvidia has a plan to keep its GPUs from losing value by convincing a new crop of financiers to keep lending for AI buildouts.

items.title: In a first, US will allow some private firms to carry out cyberattacks
items.title_zh: 美国首次允许部分私营企业实施网络攻击
items.summary: A new US order sweeps away decades of policy prohibiting private companies from conducting 'hack back' attacks or offensive cyber operations, according to TechCrunch.

items.title: Tesla defeats Sweden’s IF Metall union after 1,021-day strike
items.title_zh: 特斯拉击败瑞典 IF Metall 工会：1021 天罢工结束
items.summary: Sweden's largest industrial union IF Metall is calling off its strike against Tesla after 1,021 days — the longest labor conflict in modern Swedish history — because Tesla bought out every striking member, leaving the walkout nothing to withhold.

items.title: WeChat AI Team Details WeLM Models Scaling to 617B Parameters
items.title_zh: 微信 AI 团队披露 WeLM 模型扩展至 617B 参数
items.summary: Tencent's WeChat AI team detailed a scaling approach called Hidden Decoding for its WeLM family, training WeLM-HD4-80B and WeLM-HD4-617B models that expand each token into multiple internal computation streams without enlarging the main Transformer backbone; the 80B model activates 3 billion parameters.

items.title: Tencent Plans Larger Hy4 Model After Hy3 Usage Jumps 68-Fold
items.title_zh: 腾讯计划推出更大参数 Hy4 模型：Hy3 使用量增长 68 倍
items.summary: Tencent said its Hy3 model's weekly usage increased more than 68 times versus its predecessor after moving from preview to formal version. The company plans a larger-parameter Hy4 model in the near term without disclosing a date or specs.

items.title: Tencent Backs Lovable in $400 Million Series C at $13.3 Billion Valuation
items.title_zh: 腾讯参投 Lovable 4 亿美元 C 轮，估值 133 亿美元
items.summary: Lovable, a Stockholm-based software creation platform, raised $400 million in Series C at a $13.3 billion valuation, led by Menlo Ventures and co-led by EQT's Scaleup Europe Fund, with new investors including Tencent, Balderton Capital and Carmignac.

items.title: OpenAI previews ‘Ultrafast’ GPT-5.6 Sol running up to 14 times faster
items.title_zh: OpenAI 预览“Ultrafast”版 GPT-5.6 Sol，速度最高提升 14 倍

items.title: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
items.title_zh: 微软砍掉不成功的 AI 功能，合并独立 Copilot 应用
items.summary: Microsoft is simplifying Copilot by combining its consumer and business apps and dropping AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research and its Mico character.

items.title: X open sources its ranking algorithm, letting users see if they’ve been ‘shadowbanned’
items.title_zh: X 开源排名算法，用户可查看是否被“限流”
items.summary: X is expanding the open source code behind its 'For You' feed and launching transparency tools that show users when its ranking systems have affected their accounts or posts.

items.title: ChatGPT for Mac adds opt-in Computer History feature, replacing Chronicle
items.title_zh: ChatGPT Mac 版新增可选 Computer History 功能，取代 Chronicle
items.summary: OpenAI is giving ChatGPT and Codex a new way to learn from and remember how you use your Mac, even when work happens outside the app, via an opt-in Computer History feature.

items.title: How Organizations Use AI: Evidence from ChatGPT [pdf]
items.title_zh: 组织如何使用 AI：来自 ChatGPT 的证据
items.summary: A research paper (hosted on OpenAI's site, 65 points on Hacker News) examines how organizations use AI based on ChatGPT usage evidence.

items.title: How AI text watermarking works
items.title_zh: AI 文本水印的工作原理
items.summary: A Hacker News item (65 points) pointing to an explainer of how AI text watermarking works; no further details are published in the summary.

items.title: Gemini is getting over a dozen new connected apps – here’s the list
items.title_zh: Gemini 将新增十余款互联应用
items.summary: Gemini is expanding its integrations with over a dozen new connected apps including Ticketmaster, Angi and Zocdoc, according to 9to5Google.

items.title: Google’s Tensor G6 in Pixel 11 isn’t a 2nm smartphone chip after all
items.title_zh: Pixel 11 的 Tensor G6 并非 2nm 手机芯片
items.summary: It was rumored that Google's Tensor G6, debuting in the Pixel 11, would be the first smartphone chip using TSMC's 2nm process, but 9to5Google reports that won't be the case.

items.title: Matic Cues feature lets you just talk to your robot vacuum or point at a mess to clean
items.title_zh: Matic Cues：对扫地机器人说话或指向脏污即可清洁
items.summary: Matic added voice and gesture control to its robot vacuum and mop through a software update called Matic Cues; voice control tested as very good, e.g. "Hey Matic, vacuum the kitchen".

items.title: I finally found a robot lawnmower I’d trust with my yard
items.title_zh: 我终于找到一台敢放心用在自家院子的割草机器人
items.summary: The Verge reports robot lawnmowers are finally good enough to remove much of the work of yard maintenance, though they still require supervision to avoid damaging lawns or roaming into neighbors' yards.

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Pro API Update Adds Responses API Support
items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro API 更新：新增 Responses API 支持
items.summary: DeepSeek's API documentation now lists deepseek-v4-pro (current version DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813) with Responses API and tool call support, a 1-million-token context, 384,000-token maximum output, and a listed price of $0.003 per million tokens.

items.title: Honor Launches Robot Phone with Gimbal Camera and AI Agent Features
items.title_zh: 荣耀发布搭载云台相机与 AI 智能体的 Robot Phone
items.summary: Honor launched its Robot Phone with a four-degree-of-freedom titanium gimbal and system-level AI agent architecture: about 9.59mm thick, 248g, a 7,060mAh battery and 6.31-inch display; the 12GB+512GB version is priced at 9,999 yuan.

items.title: China’s Tablet Shipments Fall 4.4% in Q2 as Commercial Demand Surges
items.title_zh: 中国平板出货量 Q2 下降 4.4%，商用需求大增
items.summary: China's tablet market shipped 7.96 million units in Q2 2026, down 4.4% year over year. Commercial tablet shipments rose 67.1% while consumer shipments fell 9.8%; Huawei ranked first, followed by Apple, Lenovo, Xiaomi and Honor.

items.title: WeChat's Xiaowei Agent Runs on WeLM — a Sparse MoE Model Quietly Growing to 617 Billion Parameters
items.title_zh: 微信“小薇”智能体基于 WeLM：稀疏 MoE 模型悄然增至 6170 亿参数
items.summary: WeChat has started gray-testing Xiaowei, a native AI assistant inside the app powered by WeLM. WeLM has moved to a sparse MoE architecture, with the 617-billion-parameter version activating just 23 billion per token, according to Pandaily.

items.title: Alibaba Cloud Launches Qwen AI Arena for Real-World Agent Testing
items.title_zh: 阿里云发布 Qwen AI Arena：真实场景智能体评测平台
items.summary: Alibaba Cloud launched Qwen AI Arena, a challenge and evaluation platform for AI agents that creates tasks from real business scenarios and provides models, runtime environments and evaluation tools; its first challenge focuses on customer service.

items.title: Tencent's Q2 2026 Earnings Call: Three-Layer AI Strategy — Intelligence, Applications, Infrastructure — Shows Traction
items.title_zh: 腾讯 Q2 2026 财报电话会：三层 AI 战略——智能、应用与基础设施
items.summary: Pandaily covers Tencent's Q2 2026 earnings call, where the company outlined a three-layer AI strategy spanning intelligence, applications and infrastructure, showing traction.

items.title: WPS Quietly Launches Lingxi Pro, an AI-Native Office Agent That Turns Skills into Editable Documents
items.title_zh: WPS 悄然上线 Lingxi Pro：原生 AI 办公智能体
items.summary: Kingsoft's WPS quietly launched Lingxi Pro, a standalone AI-native office agent that makes AI the first entry point instead of a document feature, integrated with the WPS cloud ecosystem's 678 million monthly active devices and turning skills into native, editable Word and PPT files.

items.title: Shunwei and CATL-Backed Wangqian Bet on NOUSBOT to Mass-Produce the World's Smallest Screws by the Millions
items.title_zh: 顺为与宁德时代系望前资本押注 NOUSBOT：百万级量产全球最小丝杠
items.summary: NOUSBOT, a precision transmission parts supplier that mass-produced the world's smallest planetary roller screw at 1.5mm diameter, closed a nearly 100 million yuan A+ round led by Shunwei Capital with CATL-affiliated Wangqian Capital following, aiming to lift annual capacity.

items.title: Nanjing University and Renshine Publish Meter-Scale Perovskite Modules in Nature — 22% Certified Efficiency With Field-Proven Gains Over Silicon
items.title_zh: 南大与仁烁光能 Nature 发表米级钙钛矿组件：认证效率 22%
items.summary: A Nanjing University team led by Xiao Ke and Hairen Tan, with Renshine's industrialization team, published in Nature a lead-carboxylate passivation strategy yielding 22.0% certified full-area efficiency on 0.72m2 perovskite solar modules, passing IEC61215/IEC61730 reliability testing.

items.title: 物理AI重塑中国制造的全球竞争力：从世界工厂、工厂的工厂到工业基础模型的跃迁
items.title_zh: 物理AI重塑中国制造的全球竞争力：从世界工厂、工厂的工厂到工业基础模型的跃迁
items.summary: 文章讨论物理 AI 如何重塑中国制造的全球竞争力，提出中国正从“世界工厂”“工厂的工厂”向工业基础模型跃迁。

items.title: Agent 开始干正事，大厂终于给它装上了质检线
items.title_zh: Agent 开始干正事，大厂终于给它装上了质检线
items.summary: 文章讨论各大厂开始为 AI 智能体建立质量检测与评估机制，使其从演示走向可用的真实业务场景。

items.title: 硅谷大厂又不需要伦理学家了
items.title_zh: 硅谷大厂又不需要伦理学家了
items.summary: 文章讨论硅谷大厂 AI 伦理团队收缩现象，其本质是学术独立性与商业密闭性的对抗。

items.title: Chinese missile AI tracks F-22, F-35-like heat signatures with over 90% accuracy
items.title_zh: 中国导弹 AI 以超 90% 准确率跟踪 F-22/F-35 类热信号
items.summary: SCMP reports Chinese researchers have developed missile AI that tracks heat signatures similar to F-22 and F-35 fighters with over 90% accuracy, addressing the challenge that stealth fighters still emit infrared signals.

items.title: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
items.title_zh: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness：DeepSeek Harness，万物皆插件
items.summary: DeepSeek Harness, described as "Everything is a Plugin", is trending on GitHub as the official DeepSeek harness repository.

items.title: Leutenegger/book-to-skill
items.title_zh: Leutenegger/book-to-skill：把技术书 PDF 变成 Claude Code 技能
items.summary: book-to-skill turns any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill, ready to study, reference and use while working.

items.title: xoreaxeaxeax/skitter-creek-bath-salts
items.title_zh: xoreaxeaxeax/skitter-creek-bath-salts：DRAM 加扰研究
items.summary: A project about "unlocking everything on the CPU with DRAM scrambling", trending on GitHub with a memory-chips focus match.

items.title: ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI
items.title_zh: ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI：DeepSeek Harness 终端 TUI 插件
items.summary: A community terminal TUI plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh), featuring a Claude Code-style full-screen interactive interface with pixel-whale top bar, streaming thought display and double-Esc rollback.

items.title: elie222/rakazo
items.title_zh: elie222/rakazo：开源 Grok Bot 替代方案
items.summary: rakazo is an open-source alternative to Grok Bot, letting users choose their own model and sandbox.

items.title: NousResearch/Hermes-Bot-Mode
items.title_zh: NousResearch/Hermes-Bot-Mode：Hermes 桌面端 Bot Mode 插件
items.summary: Bot Mode for the Hermes desktop adds a roster of named agents with their own chats, avatars, routines and bot-to-bot messaging, as a desktop plugin with no core patches.

items.title: fellowgeek/mcp-memory
items.title_zh: fellowgeek/mcp-memory：基于 OKF 的 MCP 持久记忆服务
items.summary: mcp-memory is an OKF-backed Model Context Protocol server delivering persistent long-term memory and SQLite FTS5 search for AI agents.

items.title: manhvann/codexkit
items.title_zh: manhvann/codexkit：项目本地 Codex 工作区套件
items.summary: codexkit is a project-local Codex workspace kit with reusable skills, agents, hooks, plans, docs and helper scripts for multi-repository development.
